mechanism_families.core_mechanism: Disintegrate each auxiliary presentation over its retained posterior and apply the finite relative-entropy chain rule.
mechanism_families.representation: A normalized finite joint P_REO and recognition Q_RE=Q_R eta(E|R).
mechanism_families.invariant_or_obstruction: The retained law fixes evidence and posterior; unresolved auxiliary recognition contributes a nonnegative conditional KL.
obligations: State the support boundary for equality and uniqueness.
mechanism_families.bridge: Posterior completion or conditional minimization maps the full-latent objective to the retained objective.
mechanism_families.failure_test: A finite supported counterexample to the chain rule, equality condition, or minimizing joint law rejects the family.
verified_results: Collapsed VFE descent, exact conditional-KL defect, and unique minimizing joint law on the supported finite tier.
open_gaps: Continuum disintegration and section-space probability remain outside this finite result.
mechanism_families.novelty_fingerprint: retained posterior + auxiliary disintegration + conditional KL + null-node defect

mechanism_families.core_mechanism: Quotient finite presentations by equality of the retained joint law and completed conditioning algebra.
mechanism_families.representation: Direct, latent-chain, and independent-null-node binary XOR presentations on a common parameter manifold.
mechanism_families.invariant_or_obstruction: Every retained-law functional is constant on quotient fibers; full latent and intervention data need not be.
obligations: Compute retained and full Fisher tensors.
mechanism_families.bridge: Parameterwise equality of the retained family identifies retained scores and Fisher pullbacks.
mechanism_families.failure_test: Failure of normalization, the retained marginal identity, or any exact Fisher value rejects the witness.
verified_results: Retained Fisher descent and exact non-descent of full Fisher, auxiliary intervention structure, and arbitrary full VFE.
open_gaps: No canonical representative or autonomous-agent criterion follows from the quotient alone.
mechanism_families.novelty_fingerprint: binary XOR dilation + null-node insertion + rank-one retained Fisher + diagonal full Fisher + intervention obstruction

mechanism_families.core_mechanism: Construct multiple smooth right inverses of paired binary marginalization and compare the induced full-joint VFE and Fisher pullbacks.
mechanism_families.representation: Two-dimensional open marginal square mapped into the four-outcome simplex interior.
mechanism_families.invariant_or_obstruction: Marginalization erases dependence derivatives, so identical paired marginals can support inequivalent joint families.
obligations: Prove positivity, normalization, smoothness, and right-inverse identities.
mechanism_families.bridge: A declared lift promotes paired marginal sections to a full joint recognition family.
mechanism_families.failure_test: A failed positivity/right-inverse identity or equality of both induced objects rejects the witness.
verified_results: Explicit product and correlated lifts with the same marginals but different VFE values and Fisher tensors.
open_gaps: No intrinsic lift-selection principle is supplied.
mechanism_families.novelty_fingerprint: smooth Frechet-class lift + dependence perturbation + VFE gap + indefinite Fisher residual

mechanism_families.core_mechanism: Augment observational equivalence with intervention data or an independent agency axiom before selecting an agentization.
mechanism_families.representation: A category of presentations carrying retained laws plus typed intervention kernels and candidate selection rules.
mechanism_families.invariant_or_obstruction: Observational quotient fibers contain presentations with nonisomorphic intervention structures.
obligations: State a naturality or universality criterion.
Prove existence and uniqueness up to the declared isomorphism.
mechanism_families.bridge: Additional operational data would be needed to turn an observational node presentation into an agency claim.
mechanism_families.failure_test: Two enriched-equivalent presentations with different selected agentizations, or no natural selection, defeats a proposed rule.
open_gaps: No canonical agentization theorem is proved.
mechanism_families.novelty_fingerprint: observational quotient + intervention enrichment + natural representative problem
